answer.report_md:
本页是跨页续图：只有面板，没有图号、标题、单位说明、Source/StatLink。生成器需要能画 15 个小倍数折线面板（Japan…United Kingdom），每个面板自带标题、自带灰底绘图区、自带纵轴量程（Japan -20~60、Latvia -30~75、Mexico -60~150、Poland -40~100、Türkiye -200~800），共用顶部灰色横条图例 "Nominal minimum wage" / "Real minimum wage"，黑色零线，阶梯状折线，x 轴 "May-19"…"May-24" 半年刻度并倾斜排列。

取值困难在于：图上不印任何数字，全靠对轴读数；Mexico 刻度间距 30、Türkiye 间距 200，读 90、700 的容差极大；且同一数值（如 17、12）在多个国家面板都可能出现，一行表格必须同时给出国家名+系列名+日期才能唯一定位，而本页连图号都没有，无法把行系到某个 "Figure"。

不确定：面板内是否有白色网格线（似为纵向），以及 10、16、35 具体对应哪个国家的哪个时点。

components.evidence: 15 panels: Japan, Korea, Latvia ... Türkiye, United Kingdom, same chart repeated
each panel bears a bold country name above it: "Japan", "Korea", "Latvia"
one legend strip governs all 15 panels: "Nominal minimum wage", "Real minimum wage"
grey banner with the two series keys sits above the top row of panels
Japan -20 to 60, Latvia -30 to 75, Mexico -60 to 150, Türkiye -200 to 800
nominal series rises in flat treads and vertical risers, e.g. Mexico, Slovak Republic
a black horizontal rule at zero drawn across every panel
Latvia real line dips near -20; Netherlands real line below zero around Nov-22
"May-19", "Nov-19" ... "May-24" set at about 45 degrees under each panel
time written as "May-19", "Nov-20", "May-24" rather than ISO dates
lines step monthly but ticks appear only every six months, May and Nov
each plot area filled light grey behind the two lines
15 panels x 2 series x ~61 monthly points of line data
